literal_meaning: হাত (hand) + করা (to do/make); to bring under one's hand or control literally
figurative_meaning_bn: আয়ত্ব করা, বশ করা; বশে আনা/রাখা, স্বপক্ষে আনা
figurative_meaning_en: To exercise authority over, to subdue; to bring under control or keep under control, to bring to one's own side
similar_in_english: To have someone in one's pocket
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি টাকা দিয়ে থানাকে হাত করেছেন।
আমরা প্রতিপক্ষের নেতাকে হাত করে নিয়েছি।
example_sentences_in_english: He bought off the police station with money.
We have brought the opposition leader under our control.
note: This idiom often implies corrupt practices like bribery in everyday Bengali usage.
